note: Task script for a usability session with real dispatchers. api_check is a state check used to confirm a task can be completed on the stack; it is not a measure of the participant.

tasks.title: Find the most severe active alarm and acknowledge it
tasks.prompt: An alarm needs attention. Find the most severe one and acknowledge it.

tasks.title: Open the single-line diagram for a substation and read a breaker state
tasks.prompt: Tell me whether the first breaker of any substation is open or closed.

tasks.title: Run an N-1 contingency study and name the worst case
tasks.prompt: Which single outage is the most severe?

tasks.title: Switch the interface to Hindi and the dark theme
tasks.prompt: Change the language and the theme.
tasks.success: UI shows Hindi labels and chosen theme

tasks.title: Issue a breaker command with the required confirmation
tasks.prompt: Open the named breaker, following whatever the system asks of you.
tasks.success: command executed and in the audit log

tasks.title: Write a shift-handover note
tasks.prompt: Leave a note for the next shift saying one line is out for maintenance.
